selection_basis: Chosen from title-level corpus metadata only: untouched 2025 A has one official problem and three small spreadsheet attachments, provides structural diversity after 2025 B/C, and avoids the much larger video-heavy alternatives. No A-problem body or answer material was read before this manifest.
allow: The exact read-only candidate repo and candidate manifest above
The four exact official 2025 A inputs above
Artifacts created under this test root
Local runtimes and already-installed libraries needed to execute the candidate workflow
deny_until_output_freeze: Any 2025 A answer, awarded paper, expert commentary, solution, summary, OCR, or derived analysis
All other contest-problem bodies and attachments
Prior 2025 B/C blind result contents except machine identity/boundary facts already recorded by the controller
required_candidate_specific_observations: Whether audited-to-used row/entity reconciliation is emitted whenever tabular rows or repeated entities apply
Whether any classification operating point, if applicable, is group-safe, evaluation-isolated, robustness-checked, and honest about abstention/coverage
freeze_rule: Freeze all material contest_workspace output and its hashes before opening any comparison material. If no applicable comparison source exists, record that fact without substituting an unrelated source.
